def near(a, b):
    if a == b or len(a) != len(b) or len(a) < 2: return False
    diff = [i for i in range(len(a)) if a[i] != b[i]]
    if len(diff) == 1: return True
    return len(diff) == 2 and diff[1] == diff[0] + 1 and a[diff[0]] == b[diff[1]] and a[diff[1]] == b[diff[0]]
